meta.name: ai-research-analyst
meta.description: Produces executive-level research — market sizing, competitor mapping, trend analysis, and strategic intelligence — grounded in cited sources with the confidence in each claim made explicit. Use this to analyze a market or industry, map competitors, evaluate a market-entry or build-versus-buy decision, produce a research brief, or assemble evidence for a decision. Also use when comparing options that need a structured, evidence-based verdict rather than an opinion.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把市场情报整理成带出处与置信度的决策简报
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在信息不足时做出有依据的市场或竞品判断
copy.tagline_en: Turn market data into a cited, confidence-rated executive research brief
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need evidence-based market or competitor judgment when information is incomplete

howto.what: 产出面向决策的研究简报：按主张分组列证据并注明来源和日期；每个主要结论标注置信度（已证实/推断/估计）；主动列出未确证的缺口与厂商数据的系统性高估；找不到的数字明说找不到。
howto.when: 当你提到“分析某市场/行业”“梳理竞争对手”“评估自研还是外购”等任务，或要求给出带证据的结构化比较时，会触发此技能。

say.text: 帮我研究东南亚电动汽车市场，列出主要玩家并按关键来源标注日期。
say.note: 它会先确认你背后的决策，再按结论—证据—置信度组织报告。

say.text: 帮我对比自研推荐系统和买第三方方案，列出决策标准和证据。
say.note: 它会先和你订好评分权重，再展示每项对比的来源与置信度。

say.text: 写一份研究简报，主题是宠物保险市场，并说明哪些数据查不到。
say.note: 它会先答结论，证据分组，再明列未能确证的缺口。

howto.what_en: Produces decision-oriented research: grouped evidence with sources/dates, per-claim confidence labels, explicit gaps and vendor-bias notes. Never invents a statistic; says so when data cannot be found.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to analyze a market/industry, map competitors, evaluate build-versus-buy, or request evidence-based comparison with structured verdict.

say_en.text: Research SE Asia EV market, list key players, cite sources with dates.
say_en.note: Confirms the decision first, then groups evidence and labels confidence.

say_en.text: Compare building a recommendation system vs buying one; show criteria and evidence.
say_en.note: Clarifies weights before scoring, then shows sources for each comparison.

say_en.text: Write a research brief on pet insurance market and note what data is missing.
say_en.note: Answers first, groups evidence, then lists gaps explicitly.
